parts:
The approach below works for me and may work in your case as well

require(raster)
brd2 <- raster::geom(boundary) 
##boundary or outline of the study area. NB: if you have polygons within the boundary e.g. state boundaries in a national map, make sure you dissolve or use the national boundaries only.
keeps <- c("x", "y")
brd2 <- brd2[,keeps]
plot(brd2)
